texto: High frequency verbs: **fare → fatto**, **dire → detto**, **scrivere → scritto**, **aprire → aperto**, **chiudere → chiuso**, **mettere → messo**, **bere → bevuto**, **rispondere → risposto**. Look out! **Dare → dato** is completely regular in -ato.
It corresponds to Spanish «does»: **due giorni fa** (two days ago), **tre mesi fa** (three months ago), **un'ora fa** (an hour ago). It is always postponed to temporary expression.
**Ieri** (yesterday), **l'altro ieri** (before yesterday), **la settimana scorsa** (last week). «Not yet.» uses **non ancora**: **Non ho ancora scritto la risposta**.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: irregular participles and time elapsed

frases.it: Hai scritto il messaggio a Luca?
frases.en: Did you write Luca the message?

frases.it: No, non ancora. Ho fatto colazione adesso.
frases.es: No, todavía no. Desayuné ahora mismo.
frases.en: No, not yet. I had breakfast right now.

frases.it: Sì, ho già bevuto il caffè stamattina.
frases.es: Sí, ya tomé el café esta mañana.
frases.en: Yeah, I already had the coffee this morning.

frases.it: E che cosa hai fatto dopo?
frases.en: And what did you do next?

frases.it: Ho messo il telefono sul tavolo e gli scrivo subito.
frases.es: Puse el teléfono sobre la mesa y le escribo enseguida.
frases.en: I put the phone on the table and I'll write to you right away.
analisis: I'll write to you right away.

opciones.explicacion: It is irregular and is written with double t.
A non-existent Italian form.
Wrong analog form; «fare» is irregular.

bloques.pregunta: What auxiliary is used with the verb «viaggiare»?

opciones.explicacion: Although expressing general displacement, «viaggiare» takes «avere» (ho viaggiate).
«Essere» is reserved for specific verbs of change of place as andare or venire.
It doesn't work as an auxiliary to the prossimo passage.

bloques.pregunta: How does «I had to work yesterday.» translate?

opciones.explicacion: «Dovere» takes the «avere» Auxiliary from the «lavorare» verb.
«Lavorare» is conjugated with «avere», so the modal carries «avere».
The modal is conjugated into a participle, not the subordinate verb.

bloques.frase: Stamattina ho ___ un caffè caldo a casa.

opciones.explicacion: «Bere» has irregular participle in «bevuto».
Failed regular termination not applicable to this verb.
Incorrect Dysinence for «bere» root.

bloques.frase: Ho scritto un messaggio due giorni fa.

opciones.texto: I wrote a message two days ago.
opciones.explicacion: The construction period + «fa» is equivalent to «does...».

opciones.texto: I've been writing a message for two days.
opciones.explicacion: It does not express a continuing action, but a timely fact concluded.

opciones.texto: I have to write a message in two days.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses the past over, not a future plan.

bloques.frase: Ho aperto la porta e ho chiuso le finestre.

opciones.texto: I opened the door and closed the windows.
opciones.explicacion: «Aperto» and «chiuso» are the apire and chiudere participles.

opciones.texto: I closed the door and opened the windows.
opciones.explicacion: Reverse the meaning of both participles.

opciones.texto: I open the door and close the windows.
opciones.explicacion: Translate in the present instead of prossimo passage.

bloques.frase: Non ho ancora finito il lavoro di oggi
bloques.traduccion: I haven't finished today's work yet.
bloques.explicacion: «Non … ancora» frames the auxiliary to express «Not yet.».

bloques.pregunta: How do you say in Italian «Three years ago»?

opciones.explicacion: The time amount is expressed and the particle «fa» is added at the end.
In Italian «fa» cannot be put before the number.
«Prima» means «before», not «does» from the present.

intro: Many essential verbs have irregular participle. You will also learn to express time spent with «fa».
